description: What a browser window may ask the Rust side to do. Deliberately narrow: every filesystem and network operation goes through this app's own commands, not through a plugin the webview can call directly. The one exception is the dialog plugin's open picker, which is how Upload learns a path — the webview's own file input yields File objects, and it is granted open only, never save and never ask. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` is what makes the title bar drag the window: the bar is webview content under `TitleBarStyle::Overlay`, and start-dragging is not in `core:window:default`. The quit confirmation (E23-S1) is a system modal raised from Rust through the plugin's own API, which needs no permission here; granting `dialog:allow-ask` would hand every page in the webview the ability to put a modal on screen, to save nothing. `windows` names the config's `main` plus the label pattern `new_window` builds — a second window needs the same commands as the first, and widening this to every window would grant them to any window this app ever grows, including ones with a different job.
